summary: Scorpio Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) attaching a press release with Phase Two drill results at the Manhattan District, Nevada. It reports gold intercepts (e.g., 2.05 g/t over 97.99m in hole 26MN-110) but discloses no M&A, tender, or special-corporate event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or shareholder actions are present. This is a routine operational update — not an Acquisition, Divestiture, Strategic Review, or other special situation category. The filing is solely a drilling-results announcement.
